literal: Physical feature resembling human resemblance is not indeed; highly worthy character resembling that which equals is resemblance.
translation: Resembling others in physical form is not true human resemblance. Resembling them in excellent character is the only true resemblance.
modern: உடலமைப்பால் மற்றவர்களைப் போல இருப்பது உண்மையான மனித ஒப்புமை ஆகாது. சிறந்த பண்புகளால் மற்றவர்களோடு ஒத்திருப்பதே உண்மையான ஒப்புமை ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines what makes someone truly human by contrasting physical appearance with inner character. The phrase "உறுப்பு ஒத்தல்" refers to having the same body parts as other people, which the poet states is not true human resemblance. Instead, true equality comes from "பண்பு ஒத்தல்"—sharing the excellent, worthy qualities ("வெறுத்தக்க பண்பு") that define humanity. The repetition of the word "ஒப்பு" (resemblance or equality) emphasizes that biological similarity is superficial, while moral character is the true measure of a person.
